highlights: The board expects to appoint a permanent MD & CEO within four months, while near-term priorities remain sustaining growth, improving cost efficiencies, and ensuring organisational stability.  Improved return profile; maintain BUY.
We expect loan growth to remain healthy at ~25% in FY27, with NIM recovering by ~20bps over the next two quarters as surplus liquidity is deployed.
Sustained fee income growth and operating leverage should further support profitability, partly offset by a normalisation in credit costs in 2HFY27.
Management highlighted that the experienced leadership team and institutionalised processes across business, collections, and governance provide continuity.
valuation: We maintain BUY with a target price of Rs75, based on 1.0x Sep-28E adjusted book value.
Despite the improving return profile, our valuation multiple remains conservative, reflecting uncertainty around the CEO succession.
Management indicated potential for disbursements to exceed internal targets in the current quarter.
watch: Key Points  Equitas Bank organised an analyst call on the evening of 12-Nov following the appointment of the interim MD & CEO.
